Subject: Discovery recap & procurement framing - Novatech evaluation

Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps:

Pain points & goals
- Current latency variability on your inference endpoints (p90/p95 spikes) causing poor UX on high-concurrency traffic
- Cost: high per-token spend on peak batch runs - goal to reduce unit cost ~30%
- Compliance: data residency for EU customers and audit logs for SOC2

Current stack
- Model hosting: mix of on-prem and AWS SageMaker endpoints
- Orchestration: internal autoscaler + prefix caching; no unified routing across regions

Success criteria for pilot
- 99th pct latency for critical route <200ms
- 30% reduction in per-token serving cost for production traffic pattern
- No changes to customer data flow (support VPC/private deployment)

Procurement / decision process
- Timeline: pilot kickoff targeted by 8/23, production rollout early Q4
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Priya Menon (Procurement) and CTO Shankar Rao - we'll need procurement + security for PO and contract review
- Initial commercial guardrails: pilot commercial cap ~$50k (consumable credit) or fixed pilot price; target production ARR / license discussion after pilot (we can provide example guardrails)

Attachments
- Attached a one-page mutual action plan and a sample pilot pricing spreadsheet (redwood_mmp_draft_20260803.pdf, redwood_pilot_pricing_20260803.xlsx)

Next steps
1) Align on pilot scope and timeline - propose 30-min PO & security intro with Priya + your security lead this week
2) We'll share a short pilot SOW + sample PO/terms for procurement review
3) Technical deep-dive with Rishi (SE) to map integration points

If that sounds right, can you confirm who to loop in from procurement and security and whether 8/6 or 8/9 afternoon (PDT) work for a short call?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147

Quick clarifications:
- Correct on latency/cost being the main blockers. Our SRE team has seen p95 spikes up to ~450ms during flash sales.
- Budget: For pilot we have flexibility; Priya and I discussed an initial guardrail of up to $40-60k for a 6-week pilot. Production budgeting TBD but leadership wants a clear ROI case.

Stakeholders to loop in now: Priya (procurement), Lina Gomez (Head of Security, l.gomez@novatech.com), and Shankar Rao (CTO). I've cc'd Priya here - she’ll own the PO flow.

Availability: Priya can do Friday 8/6 10:00-10:30am PT. Can Vivek and your legal rep join? Also please send a short pilot SOW and an example PO/terms ahead of that call.

Alex
